clubs.name: Robotics & Innovation Club
clubs.description: Design, build and program robots. We take part in national robotics competitions and run hands-on workshops on Arduino, sensors and automation.
clubs.objectives: Promote innovation and practical engineering skills; prepare teams for national competitions; share knowledge through peer workshops.

clubs.name: Coding & Cyber Club
clubs.description: A community for programmers. We practise problem solving, web development and basic cyber security through weekly challenges and hackathons.
clubs.objectives: Improve coding skills; encourage open-source projects; raise cyber security awareness on campus.

clubs.name: Literary & Debate Club
clubs.description: Sharpen your public speaking, writing and critical thinking through debates, poetry evenings, quiz contests and the annual college magazine.
clubs.objectives: Build confidence in public speaking; promote reading culture; publish the college magazine.

clubs.name: Cultural Club
clubs.description: Preserve and celebrate Bhutanese culture through traditional songs (zhungdra and boedra), mask dances and cultural programmes during college events.
clubs.objectives: Promote Bhutanese tradition and Driglam Namzha; perform at college and national events.

clubs.name: Sports & Archery Club
clubs.description: Football, basketball, volleyball and our national sport — archery. We organise inter-department tournaments and represent JNEC at RUB games.
clubs.objectives: Encourage a healthy lifestyle; build team spirit; train teams for inter-college tournaments.

clubs.name: Nature & Environment Club
clubs.description: Protect the environment of Dewathang and our campus through clean-up campaigns, tree plantation and awareness on waste management.
clubs.objectives: Keep the campus green and clean; promote waste segregation; support national environment days.

clubs.name: Photography & Media Club
clubs.description: Capture campus life! Learn photography, video editing and social media content creation. We cover all major college events.
clubs.objectives: Document college events; teach photography and editing skills; manage the college media page.

clubs.name: Y-Peer & Health Club
clubs.description: Peer educators promoting mental health, healthy habits and first aid. We run blood donation drives and awareness sessions.
clubs.objectives: Promote physical and mental well-being; train students in basic first aid; organise blood donation.
